text: Good evening, I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she is 11 months old. Her temperature is 38.2. She's got a few insect bites on her arms that she keeps scratching at, and I think she's teething too, dribbling like a tap, chewing on everything she can grab and one cheek is all red. Her breathing is normal, I've watched her. I may be fussing over nothing but her mum's away and I'd rather ask.
